cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Name My Contribution
cards.instruction: Get them to acknowledge exactly what your effort, sacrifice, or strategy added to the result.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: In the trip debrief, say what my spreadsheet actually did. 'A great help' isn't a finding.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It kept track of the hotel bookings.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It found thirty bookings the hotel had lost. Please distinguish tracking from recovery.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then I'll say you saved the trip.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Too broad. Say we recovered thirty rooms before the coach arrived. Keep the time in; otherwise it sounds as though I counted everyone after they'd slept in the foyer.

reason: Let B over-credit helpfully and A correct toward precise effort/result rather than demand generic praise.
